tools.label: Tools
tools.title: Every tool, one canvas.
tools.body: Start with a photo, a template or an idea. Every tool opens in the same editor, so you never juggle tabs or re-upload.

editor.name: Photo editor
editor.benefit: Light, color and crop with sliders that respond instantly. Your original is never touched.

bg.name: Background remover
bg.benefit: Lift the subject off any background in one click.

ai.name: AI image generator
ai.benefit: Describe a scene and get images you can keep editing.
ai.prompt: a ceramic vase on linen, morning light

templates.name: Templates
templates.benefit: Posts, stories and flyers sized for every platform.

collage.name: Collage
collage.benefit: Drop in photos and let the grid do the layout.

how.label: How it works
how.title: From photo to post in three moves.
how.body: No installs, no layers to learn. Bring a photo in, shape the light, and take it to whatever you're posting.

upload.title: Bring a photo in
upload.body: Drag, paste or pick a JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF or HEIC. It lands in your private library, metadata stripped.

adjust.title: Adjust and style
adjust.body: Exposure, contrast, color and filters on a canvas that never overwrites your original.

export.title: Export anywhere
export.body: Download PNG, JPG or WebP sized for the place you're posting it.

formats.label: Formats
formats.title: Sized for every feed.
formats.body: One photo, framed for every place it needs to go. Pick a size and the canvas fits itself.
formats.badge: Canvas presets arrive with the editor

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Your photos stay yours.
privacy.body: Private by default, from the moment a file lands. These are things that work today, not promises.

private.title: Private to your workspace
private.body: Uploads are visible only to you. Nothing is public, nothing is shared.

exif.title: Location data stripped
exif.body: Every upload is re-encoded and its EXIF metadata, including GPS location, is removed.

delete.title: Delete anytime
delete.body: Remove an upload and its files go with it. No trash folder to empty.

export.title: Take your data with you
export.body: Download everything as a file, or delete your account from Settings.

faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Everything people ask first.
faq.curious: Still curious? Email the team. We read every message.

free.a: Yes. PixelForge is free while it's in beta. Paid plans with more AI credits and bigger exports come later, and we'll tell you before anything changes.

today.a: Create an account, upload photos into your private library, and manage them from Home and Uploads. Uploads are checked, re-encoded and thumbnailed in seconds.

next.a: The photo editor is next: adjustments, filters, crop and export. Templates and AI tools like background removal and image generation follow.

privacy.a: Only you. Uploads are private to your workspace, location metadata is stripped, and you can delete any file or your whole account at any time.

formats.a: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF and HEIC, up to 25 MB per file on the Free plan.

cta.title: Your next photo deserves better light.
cta.body: Free during beta. No card, nothing to install.
